tasks.title: Implement decided audit corrections with claude-code carryover scope
tasks.goal: Execute the audit correction plan phases 1-3 as decided in docs/AUDIT_RESPONSES.md: trust reconciliation (canonical doctor in CI health, pinned actions, accurate validators index, codex-layer README), legacy hygiene (doctor bootstrap hint, docs/legacy archive, PowerShell deprecation, SECURITY_GUARDRAILS rename) and refinements (POSIX hook shims, data domain removal, language policy), plus the AGENTS/CLAUDE source-order drift gate. The uncommitted claude-code coexistence slice files remain declared as carryover scope.

agentGoal.draft: /goal Implement audit correction phases 1-3 per docs/AUDIT_RESPONSES.md with mechanical gates green and the deprecated workflow removal still gated on the prerelease.
agentGoal.outcome: Health and review workflows run the canonical Node doctor with SHA-pinned actions, doctor gives an npm ci hint on missing dependencies, control-plane legacy is fenced under docs/legacy and scripts/legacy, the guardrails doc no longer collides with root SECURITY.md, POSIX hook shims delegate to canonical validators, and CLAUDE.md cannot drift from AGENTS.md silently.
agentGoal.verificationSurface: npm run doctor, npm run validate:adapters, npm test, npm run validate, git diff --check and docs/REVIEW.md evidence
constraints: Do not remove the deprecated numbered workflows before one release cycle after the 2.0.0-rc.1 prerelease.
Do not edit verified or archived sprint JSON records; discrepancies become errata.
Keep deploy.ps1 as the deploy workflow wrapper.
agentGoal.iterationPolicy: Use the smallest change that satisfies the failing verification.
agentGoal.blockedStopCondition: Stop if a gate cannot pass without touching a closed historical record or removing the gated deprecated workflows.

acceptanceCriteria: Health and review workflows run the canonical doctor with SHA-pinned actions.
Doctor fails with an npm ci hint when pinned dependencies are missing.
Control-plane era docs and duplicated PowerShell helpers are fenced as legacy with updated index and gates.
CLAUDE.md source order cannot drift from AGENTS.md without failing adapter validation.
POSIX hook shims delegate to the canonical Node validators.

evidence.criterion: Health and review workflows run the canonical doctor with SHA-pinned actions.
evidence.result: Regression asserts environment-health runs npm ci plus npm run doctor and that every uses: entry in both workflows is a 40-hex SHA.

evidence.criterion: Doctor fails with an npm ci hint when pinned dependencies are missing.
evidence.result: Bootstrap regression runs the copied doctor in a temp directory without node_modules and asserts exit 1 with the npm ci message and no raw module-not-found stack.

evidence.criterion: Control-plane era docs and duplicated PowerShell helpers are fenced as legacy with updated index and gates.
evidence.result: Full validation green after the docs/legacy and scripts/legacy moves, SECURITY_GUARDRAILS rename, index update and workflow gate updates.

evidence.criterion: CLAUDE.md source order cannot drift from AGENTS.md without failing adapter validation.
evidence.result: Adapter validation compares the numbered Source Order lists of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md and passes with the aligned surfaces.

evidence.criterion: POSIX hook shims delegate to the canonical Node validators.
evidence.result: Regression executes codex-layer/hooks/check-no-secrets.sh through sh and observes the canonical scanner output with exit 0.
